2607.21185.title: Differentiable Logic Programming to Mitigate Reasoning Shortcuts in Neurosymbolic Systems
2607.21185.paper_summary: Neurosymbolic (NeSy) systems integrate neural networks with logical reasoning to achieve both generalization and interpretability, but recent work has shown they are susceptible to shortcut reasoning behaviors.  We propose a novel method using matrix-based differentiable logic programming to mitigate reasoning shortcuts in two phenomena: constraint satisfaction shortcuts, where constraints are satisfied without achieving the intended task, and cognition shortcuts, where biased data leads to semantically incorrect concept mappings despite logically sound inference. Building on recent matrix-based logic programming semantics, we introduce design elements to mitigate shortcuts, including a unified encoding of rules and constraints in a single matrix.  We also identify connections to fuzzy logic t-norms and empirically compare their gradient flow properties. Through carefully designed experiments on MNIST variants, we show that one-to-one grounding of neural outputs to logical atoms significantly reduces both shortcut types compared to previous methods that rely on soft probability distributions.  We then confirm that architectural choices in coupling symbolic knowledge with neural learning play a critical role in shortcut mitigation.
2607.21185.paper_summary_zh: 神經符號（NeSy）系統將神經網絡與邏輯推理結合，以實現泛化和可解釋性，但最近的研究顯示它們容易受到捷徑推理行為的影響。<lb/>我們提出了一種新方法，使用基於矩陣的可微邏輯編程來減輕兩種現象中的推理捷徑：約束滿足捷徑，這種情況下約束在未達成預期任務的情況下被滿足；以及認知捷徑，這種情況下偏見數據導致語義上不正確的概念映射，儘管推理在邏輯上是合理的。<lb/>基於最近的基於矩陣的邏輯編程語義，我們引入設計元素來減輕捷徑，包括在單一矩陣中統一編碼規則和約束。<lb/>我們還確定了與模糊邏輯 t-範數的聯繫，並實證比較了它們的梯度流特性。<lb/>通過精心設計的 MNIST 變體實驗，我們顯示神經輸出與邏輯原子的逐一對應顯著減少了兩種捷徑類型，相較於依賴於軟概率分佈的先前方法。<lb/>然後我們確認，將符號知識與神經學習耦合的架構選擇在減輕捷徑方面扮演了關鍵角色。
